title: Character
description: One small file: who the robot is. Persona text, a default face (style recipe, color, background) and voice settings. Under 1,024 bytes as compact UTF-8 (scripts/character-check.py checks it). The face style is named, never embedded: a style is its own asset (kind style, docs/design/face-styles.md).

id.description: Lower-case letters, digits and underscores. The bank's ids are the persona roster of the org standards; a copy chooses its own.

about.description: One plain sentence for the picker.

based_on.description: The id of the character this one is a copy of, when it is one.

persona.description: Plain text for the language model. Route own-LLM and Home only; hidden for a hosted vendor.

background.description: The screen color behind the face.

voice.description: Route own-LLM and Home only; hidden for a hosted vendor, whose voice is the vendor's.

local.description: A voice of the person's own speech engine. Empty or missing: the engine's default.

home.description: A voice id Home owns, stock or cloned. Empty or missing: Home's default for the language.

wake.description: Optional wake phrase. Needs a trained wake model; none ships with a default character.
